title: THE WAIT FOR
HIS LIGHT
end: The Morning Altar — begin every sunrise in prayer
stock_queries: soft morning light through sheer curtains
golden sun rays over calm river

scenes.a: That decision weighing on your heart is not too heavy for God to handle today.
I wait for the LORD, my soul doth wait, and in his word do I hope.
My soul waiteth for the Lord more than they that watch for the morning: I say, more than they that watch for the morning.
scenes.sub: HE IS COMING TO YOUR AID

scenes.a: Lord, quiet the restless parts of me that demand answers before I have even stepped forward.
Help me trust that you are working in the hidden spaces of this current season.
Let your peace anchor my soul as I walk into whatever this new day brings.
